messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Mutual action outline & proposed close cadence (first pass)

Hi Sara (and Amit),

Thanks again for a great discussion yesterday. As promised, attaching a first-pass mutual action outline and a short slides deck that lays out a proposed close cadence and the evaluation milestones we discussed. The doc is intentionally light — I want to confirm the right stakeholders and timeline before we lock anything in.

Quick summary (high level):
- Goal: 30-day technical evaluation + 30-day pilot (goal: production pilot by end of Nov).
- Milestones: kickoff -> infra prep/security review -> demo + validation -> pilot signoff.
- Ask from Alder: security questionnaire window (SOC2 evidence + retention requirements), a sample ingested dataset for perf sizing, and a sandbox access point.
- What we’ll own: Redwood will provide dedicated evaluation capacity for two weeks (reserved GPU pool), initial prompt templates, and an acceptance checklist.

Please take a look at the Google Doc and the slides (links below). If this cadence looks off, let me know which milestones you’d move earlier / later and whether the pilot duration should be shortened or extended.

Links / attachments:
- Alder_MUTUAL_ACTION_OUTLINE_v1.gdoc (drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=ald-mutual-action-outline-v1
- Alder_Close_Cadence_v1.gslides (drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=ald-close-cadence-v1

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm stakeholders and any blackout dates by EOD Fri 9/17.
2) We incorporate security reviewer availability and return an updated timeline on Mon 9/20.
3) Schedule kickoff workshop (45 min) for week of 9/27.

Assigning owners: I’ve put Marissa and Jasmine on the doc to capture technical and success-side tasks. Marissa — can you confirm dedicated capacity availability and a rough estimate of GPU type we’d reserve? Jasmine — can you add the acceptance checklist section with a short list of test cases?

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Mutual action outline & proposed close cadence (first pass)

Jordan — thanks for the quick turn. The outline looks good and I appreciate the clarity. A couple of asks from Alder:  

- Timeline: Can we tighten the schedule so the pilot starts two weeks earlier? Our product leadership is pushing for a faster decision window. If you can shift the kickoff to the week of 9/20 and compress the validation period, that would be ideal.
- Security: Our security team needs at least a 7-business-day window to review SOC2 artifacts and retention policies. Can you confirm Redwood’s earliest availability to share those artifacts?
- Data: We can provide a redacted sample dataset by 9/18. That should help with perf sizing.

Also looping Amit for infra questions — Amit, is there any internal constraint that would block a 9/20 kickoff?

If you can send an updated timeline (even a one-slide gantt) that shows the compressed path, we’ll review internally.

Thanks,
Sara Khan
Head of Product | Alder Therapeutics
sara.khan@alderthera.com

- Dedicated pool: Confirmed reserved capacity starting 9/21 — H100-class (2x 80GB) for two weeks. If Alder wants to extend the reserved window we can open a short-term reserved quote.

  • 9/28 — Feature validation demo (first outcomes)
  • 10/05 — Pilot acceptance signoff (end of pilot)

I’ve uploaded a small pilot scope spreadsheet with test owners and suggested acceptance thresholds (pilot_scope.xlsx). Jasmine — I added a few acceptance tests under the doc — please refine.
